aboutMe.title: About Me
paragraphs: I keep [B]computing solutions asynchronously[/B] until a problem is fully resolved — after work, while sleeping, in the middle of the night. When something is unclear, I design an experiment or dig into the source directly.

I don't sit on what I find. I believe [B]documentation and sharing is the most effective form of communication[/B]. I've written up analyses that changed my team's technical direction, and filed open source issues from findings along the way. A personal discovery becoming a team-level change is the kind of impact I find most rewarding.
I'm always [B]conscious of the tradeoff between time and quality[/B]. I don't chase perfect code — I chase the right code for where the product is.

details.text:
Test and environment (incl. mobile) growth made CI time scale linearly
	designed a [B]Dynamic Shard CI architecture[/B] that distributes shards by test count, merging the scattered per-shard reports into a single HTML report on failure ([L:https://team.allrafintech.co.kr/frontend-playwright-e2e-test-ci-optimization-d94b082509d8]blog[/L])
subItems: [B]cut pure CI time by ~30%[/B], holding it flat even as tests tripled

details.text:
Subtle UI shifts introduced by new releases were hard to catch by eye
	introduced [B]visual regression testing (VRT)[/B] on top of the E2E structure to detect them automatically
subItems: analyzed instability from OS/rendering environment differences and [B]chose to run it as a local review tool rather than a CI gate[/B]

categories.title: Consolidated state calculation into a single Provider

details.text:
In the pre-settlement application form, child components each computed fees, limits, and subsidies via [B]useEffect[/B], and accumulated business rules made the branching unmanageable
	moved all calculation into a Provider and delivered state as a [B]6-variant Discriminated Union[/B] so children only render
subItems: extracted the logic into pure functions backed by [B]80+ unit tests[/B]

categories.title: Full migration from Server Actions to a tRPC architecture

details.text:
Server Action-based architecture suffered from sequential-call limits and [B]version skew[/B] (old client bundle vs. new server on deploy), causing slow page loads and repeated build failures
	[B]designed a tRPC-based type-safe API layer and drove the migration across all domains[/B]
subItems: analyzed and [B]documented the sequential-execution constraint[/B], sharing it with the team ([L:https://codefug.github.io/posts/2026-01-29]blog[/L])

details.text:
Discovered a deep-copy bug that was silently preventing per-page metadata overrides
	traced the root cause, fixed it, and unified all page OG/Twitter metadata into [B]shared utils[/B] to prevent recurrence

Collaborated with the marketing team on SEO quality improvements
	introduced [B]Schema.org JSON-LD structured data[/B] to enhance search engine crawling quality

details.text:

subItems: eliminated duplicate API calls and stale data, [B]hardening operational stability[/B]
